svg.title: VidSense: Video RAG · final year project
svg.desc: Summaries, timestamped Q&A, highlight reels and AI podcasts from any video, with Whisper and DeepSeek-R1 running on a local GPU. Built with Whisper, Ollama, FastAPI, RAG.
